members.reason: [llm] duplicates #1531: OAuth token endpoints on some servers return `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` instead of JSON, causing the client to misparse the response. PR #1531 takes a preventive approach by adding `Accept: application/json` to both `_exchange_token` and `_refresh_token` requests so conforming servers send JSON. PR #1511 takes a defensive approach by adding a `_parse_content_type` helper and modifying `_handle_token_response` to detect and parse URL-encoded bodies when the Content-Type indicates it. Both PRs modify the same `_exchange_token` return statement in `auth.py`, creating a direct merge conflict. (2 PRs)

It fixes both `_exchange_token` and `_refresh_token` symmetrically with a minimal, standards-compliant change. PR #1511's diff is truncated mid-function in `_handle_token_response`, so its full scope and correctness cannot be verified, and no tests are visible in the shown diff.
